subtitle: View and edit Control Expert exchange files
confirmReplace: The current changes are not exported yet. Discard them and load another file?
emptyEditor: Create a new function block or load a .xdb / .xst file, then edit the ST source here.
ready: Ready. Drag a file into the window to import it. Shortcut Ctrl+S saves and parses again.
exportNote: The file has been generated. Review the conversion or compatibility notes below.

tree.title: Function blocks and sections
tree.empty: No exchange file is loaded yet. Click “New function block”, “Import file” or a demo button at the top to start.
tree.pending: The metadata draft is not confirmed yet
tree.updated: Function block name and comment updated
tree.invalidName: The function block name must start with a Latin letter or an underscore; the remaining characters may only be Latin letters, digits and underscores.
tree.reservedName: EN and ENO are system pins; they cannot be used as a function block name.

newBlock.title: New function block
newBlock.name: Function block name
newBlock.commentPlaceholder: Optional: describe the purpose of the function block
newBlock.note: Creates an empty variable table and an empty ST section. Declare variables in the variable table.
newBlock.nameRequired: The function block name cannot be empty
newBlock.nameInvalid: The function block name must start with a Latin letter or an underscore; the remaining characters may only be Latin letters, digits and underscores.
newBlock.nameReserved: EN and ENO are system pins; they cannot be used as a function block name.

actions.readOnly: Non-ST sections are read-only and cannot be saved
actions.savedMultiple: Saved {count} sections and parsed the exchange file again
actions.saved: Saved to the page memory and parsed again; export the file to keep the changes
actions.formatOnlySt: Only ST sections can be formatted
actions.formatted: ST source formatted; save to write it back to the exchange file
actions.replaced: Replaced {count} occurrences; save to write them back to the exchange file
actions.needDocument: Create a function block or import an exchange file first
actions.noDefinition: {name} has no local definition (built-in function or external symbol)
